title: Platinum Rewards Card: New Customer Promo - First Year Annual Fee Waived
summary: This document describes the Platinum Rewards Card new customer promo where, if you apply and are approved during 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31, the first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of the standard $200.00. The waiver applies for the first 12 months from account opening and does not retroactively apply to accounts opened outside the window.
